methods.label: Test the counterexample
methods.explanation: A counterexample must satisfy the hypothesis (both angles are acute) but fail to satisfy the conclusion (their sum is not acute). \(50^\circ+70^\circ=120^\circ\), which is not acute. All the other sums are less than \(90^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: The method uses grade-7 counterexample reasoning and elementary angle addition and classification.
